'''Skali Watch Your Step''' is a [[Light]] constructed list [[Skali]] published on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]].<ref name="or">[http://www.geocities.com/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/expandeduniverse/Watchyourstep.htm Watch Your Step], The Outer Rim (Skali). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021212144321/http://www.geocities.com:80/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/expandeduniverse/Watchyourstep.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Skali]]
* '''Published:''' by 12 May 2001 (The Outer Rim)
* '''Published title:''' ''Watch Your Step''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif|label=Watch Your Step}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 WYS Skali LS 2001 OuterRim.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' Watch Your Step

== Introduction ==

Skali posted this Expanded Universe Watch Your Step list on The Outer Rim. The published list has 61 cards.
